title: Construction of third unit at Taishan begins
html:
The construction of two HPR1000s (Hualong Ones) at units 3 and 4 (Phase II) of the Taishan plant were among ten new reactors approved during a meeting of the State Council on 27 April 2025, presided over by Premier Li Qiang.

China General Nuclear (CGN) has now announced that the pouring of first concrete for unit 3 took place at 10:18 on Wednesday, marking the start of the unit's civil construction phase.


(Image: CGN)

The company noted that this is the fourth nuclear power unit that CGN has started construction on this year.

"The second phase of the CGN Guangdong Taishan Nuclear Power Project will employ high-level water-collecting natural draft cooling towers, relying on atmospheric heat traps to remove waste heat from the conventional island's thermal cycle, achieving cooling water recycling," CGN said. "This will not only save energy and reduce consumption while ensuring the safety of the cooling source, but also provide strong protection for the marine environment and biodiversity."


(Image: CGN)

The Taishan plant will eventually comprise six units, constructed in three phases.

Taishan units 1 and 2 (Phase I) were the first two reactors, based on the EPR design, to begin operating. The reactors entered commercial operation in December 2018 and September 2019, respectively.
summary: The first concrete has been poured for the nuclear island of unit 3 at the Taishan nuclear power plant in Guangdong province, China General Nuclear has announced.  ;
